title: Multiple Positions - Medical, Nursing & Support Staff

eligibility: Registered and licensed professionals in respective fields
description:
John William Kiggundu (JWK) International Hospital Kakiri is a modern, private healthcare institution established to provide affordable, highly accessible, and premier quality healthcare services to the people of Uganda and the broader East African region.

**About JWK International Hospital**

Founded by Dr. Henry K. Lukwago, a visionary Ugandan physician, entrepreneur, and healthcare investor based in the United States, JWK International Hospital forms a critical milestone within his broader healthcare portfolio under Angels Mission Home Care Services, spanning healthcare, home care, pharmaceuticals, and premium hospitality in both Uganda and the United States.

Nestled in Kakiri Town, Wakiso District along the Kampala–Hoima Road, the facility opened in October 2023 as an initial 50-bed modern hospital with one of Uganda's largest specialized dialysis centers. The hospital operates with WHO Standards, 99.8% Precision Rate, and Level-1 Emergency capabilities.

**Hospital Heritage**
JWK stands for John William Kiggundu, honouring the beloved father of our founder, Dr. Henry K. Lukwago. At commissioning in October 2023, Mr. Kiggundu was 97 years old, representing nearly a century of human integrity, wisdom, and unyielding dignity—the core pillars upon which our clinical practice is built.

**Mission:** A reliable healthcare centre devoted to transforming the health status of society through professional clinical care, health education, and research.

**Vision:** To be a world-class healthcare hub in providing affordable, quality, ethical and highly specialized patient-centred care services.

**Clinical Departments:**
- 24/7 Advanced Life Support & ICU
- Advanced & General Surgery
- State-of-the-Art Dialysis Centre
- Advanced Medical Diagnostics & X-ray Wing
- Maternal & Gynaecology Suite
- Pediatric & Neonatology Clinic
- 24/7 Emergency & Trauma Hub
- Advanced Imaging & Pathology Lab
- Dental Care Unit

---

**WE ARE HIRING - AVAILABLE POSITIONS:**

**1. Medical Officer (1 Position)**
- Provide clinical care across medical, surgical, and emergency departments
- Participate in patient diagnosis, treatment, and management
- Collaborate with specialist teams for comprehensive patient care

**2. Enrolled Nurse (1 Position)**
- Deliver compassionate nursing care to patients across departments
- Administer medications and treatments as prescribed
- Maintain accurate patient health records

**3. Enrolled Midwife (1 Position)**
- Provide maternal and neonatal care services
- Assist in safe deliveries and postnatal care
- Support high-risk pregnancy monitoring under specialist guidance

**4. Dialysis Nurse (1 Position)**
- Operate and monitor dialysis equipment
- Provide specialized renal care to patients
- Ensure patient safety during dialysis procedures

**5. ICU Nurses (2 Positions)**
- Monitor critically ill patients in the Intensive Care Unit
- Operate life support and monitoring equipment
- Provide continuous high-precision patient care under the direction of intensivists

**6. Dental Officer (1 Position)**
- Provide comprehensive dental care services
- Perform dental examinations, treatments, and procedures
- Educate patients on oral health and preventive care

**7. Receptionist (1 Position)**
- Manage patient registration and reception duties
- Handle appointment scheduling and inquiries
- Provide excellent customer service to patients and visitors

**8. Radiographer (1 Position)**
- Perform diagnostic imaging procedures (X-ray, CT, MRI)
- Ensure proper operation and maintenance of imaging equipment
- Produce high-quality diagnostic images for clinical review

---

**General Requirements:**
- Valid professional registration and licensing
- Relevant qualifications from recognized institutions
- Good communication and interpersonal skills
- Ability to work in a team-oriented clinical environment
- Commitment to patient safety and quality care

**How to Apply:**

**Physical Delivery:** Hospital Admin Office, Kakiri - Opposite Police Barracks
**Email:** jwkhospital@gmail.com
**Contact:** +256 200 992 222

**Deadline:** 5th September 2026
